title: Custody document, version 2 (osd.custody/2; osd.custody/1 still validates)
description: One copy the mirror holds: what it is, where it came from, under which licence with which attribution, and how to ask for its removal. Written by `osd mirror put` (a verified download) or by the deposit and derived uploads (E41) beside the object as custody/<sha256>.json before the object becomes public; `osd mirror remove` turns it into the tombstone custody/<sha256>.removed.json. Never written by hand. The build regenerates the public index from these documents. v2 (E40): exactly one provenance: `origin_href` with `verifier_run` (a verified download, as /1), or `origin_href: null` with `deposit` (a maintainer's deposit of the publisher's download) or with `derived` (an artefact a starter-pack recipe made from held inputs). A /1 document keeps the /1 shape.

path.description: The file as the publisher's listing names it

origin_href.description: Where the bytes were copied from; null for a deposit or a derived artefact (v2), which name their provenance instead

key.description: mirror/<record id>/<sha256>/<file name> in the store

href.description: The public address of the copy

verifier_run.description: A verified download: the verification run whose inventory named this file with its bytes and sha256

deposit.description: v2 (E40; written by E41). A maintainer deposited the publisher's download: when, by which role, the publisher's page it came from and the two hashes captured then

by.description: A role (maintainer), never a person's name

publisher_page_sha256.description: The publisher's download page as captured at deposit

licence_text_sha256.description: The licence text as captured at deposit

derived.description: v2 (E40; uploaded by E41, run by E42). An artefact of a starter pack: which pack, which recipe, made from which held inputs

from.description: The sha256 of each pack input the artefact was made from

licence.description: The licence object, whole: the record's for a verified download or a deposit, the pack's computed licence for a derived artefact (v2 admits record/5 `terms`). Only `allowed` is ever mirrored (OSD-D6)

licence_text_sha256.description: The licence text the verifier captured (E02), or null when none was

attribution.description: The lines `osd get` writes to ATTRIBUTION.md for this record

takedown.description: Where to ask for removal: the takedown issue template

verified.description: A verified download (/1 and /2): origin_href and verifier_run, no other provenance
